Class PlayerPrefixEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerEvent
dev.plex.api.event.PlayerPrefixEvent
public final class PlayerPrefixEvent extends org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerEvent
Supplies additive prefixes before Plex renders a player's chat line or tab-list entry.

PlayerPrefixEvent.Target.TAB: Plex calls this synchronous event on the player's owning region at join and every 20 ticks.

PlayerPrefixEvent.Target.CHAT: Plex calls this event for each rendered chat line. The event is asynchronous when Plex renders a normal chat message. The event is synchronous when a module calls MessageApi.chatLine on a thread that can read the player.

For both targets, read cached state only. Do not perform database or network work. Each event starts with no prefixes. Add active prefixes on each call; Plex does not store them. Check getTarget() to contribute to one target only. Unregister listeners when their plugin or module stops.

Plex renders prefixes in listener order, then the tag, then the name. Plex inserts one space after each nonempty prefix and tag. In chat, the prefixes and the tag fill the <prefix> placeholder of chat.format, and the format supplies the space before the name. The base tag and name are read-only so independent plugins cannot replace them through this event.

      @NotNull public @NotNull net.kyori.adventure.text.Component getName()
      Returns the base name.

    • getTag

      @NotNull public @NotNull net.kyori.adventure.text.Component getTag()
      Returns the base tag.

      For PlayerPrefixEvent.Target.TAB, this is the custom tag. For PlayerPrefixEvent.Target.CHAT, this is the custom tag, or the rank prefix when no custom tag is set.

      Returns:
      tag without a separator, or an empty component
